title: Trump administration held talks with Iran on deporting Iranians during the war, court documents show
snippet: The documents show that the administration maintained contacts with Iranian officials during the war over the removals, specifically for submitting travel documents and figuring out "possible avenues for removal."

title: Mexican judge accused by U.S. of taking bribes in major drug case
snippet: Luiz Benítez Alcántara is accused of releasing Andrew Clark from custody after accepting $2 million in bribe payments.
